description: Net pay from a Leave and Earnings Statement: sums the entitlement lines (base pay, BAH, BAS, other) and deduction lines (federal tax, FICA, state tax, SGLI, TSP, other), and returns net pay plus deductions as a percent of entitlements. Negative line items count as zero, as on the page. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive LES decoder calculator.
name: calculate_les_decoder
